name: Supplies from Darkshire
summary: Abercrombie in western Duskwood asks travelers to fetch a rare thread from Darkshire. The hermit claims he is too frail to cross the haunted woods and asks for Ghost Hair Thread from Madame Eva.

sections.title: A Feeble Request
sections.body: North of Raven Hill Cemetery, Abercrombie lives alone in a shack in western Duskwood. He tells travelers that age and frailty keep him from making the dangerous journey through the woods to buy goods in Darkshire. His request seems simple: go to the township's town square and speak with Madame Eva for a spool of Ghost Hair Thread.

sections.title: A Curious Material
sections.body: In Darkshire, Madame Eva has no Ghost Hair Thread ready. The local diviner spins strange artifacts, but this thread is no ordinary sewing supply. To make it, she needs ghost hair from Blind Mary, a sorrowful spirit haunting a farmhouse south of Darkshire. The errand now depends on gathering what Madame Eva needs.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Supplies from Darkshire?
faq.answer: Abercrombie, a hermit in a shack north of Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood, asks for help.

faq.q: Who do I speak with in Darkshire to get the supplies?
aliases: where to turn in supplies from darkshire
faq.answer: Speak with Madame Eva, who lives in a house overlooking Darkshire's central square.

faq.q: What specific item is Abercrombie looking for?
faq.answer: Abercrombie asks for Ghost Hair Thread, an unusual material Madame Eva weaves.

faq.q: Does Madame Eva have the Ghost Hair Thread ready?
faq.answer: No. Madame Eva has none in stock when you arrive. She agrees to spin it if you gather the spectral materials she needs from nearby spirits.

faq.q: What quest precedes Supplies from Darkshire?
faq.answer: The Hermit sends travelers from Darkshire to find Abercrombie at his dwelling.

faq.q: What quest follows Supplies from Darkshire?
aliases: next quest after supplies from darkshire
faq.answer: Speaking with Madame Eva leads directly to Ghost Hair Thread. You are asked to bring a Spectral Comb to Blind Mary and gather her hair.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you may find yourself carrying messages and goods for hermits on the hazardous backroads around Darkshire.
As a tailor, you know woven items usually use linen or silk. Madame Eva's work spinning ethereal hair into thread is a macabre curiosity.
